page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries, left and right under a common running head; at the foot right a section mark (נ ת). No marginal notes.

main_text.p: נִשְׁקוּ osculati sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָשַׁק.
נִשְׁקוּ osculamini, Imper. Piel, pl. m. R. נַשֵּׁק.
נֹשְׁקִים osculantes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. constr. Rad. נָשַׁק.
נִשְׁקַל appensum est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. m. Rad. שָׁקַל.
נִשְׁקְנוּ bibendum dabimus ei, fut. Hiph. 1. plur. aff. Rad. שָׁקָה.
נִשְׁקַע submersus est, submersa est, præt. Niph. 3. f.m. & f. Rad. שָׁקַע.
נִשְׁקָף spectavit, vel spectans, הַנִּשְׁקָף hic spectans, præt. Niph. 3. f.m. & Part. Niph. f.m. Rad. שָׁקַף.
נִשְׁקָפָה spectata est, הַנִּשְׁקָפָה spectata, præt. Niph. 3. f.f. vel Part. Niph. f.fæm. Rad. שָׁקַף.
נְשָׁרִי aquilæ, מִנְּשָׁרִים præ aquilis, plur. m. præf.
No. Rad. נָשַׁר ; vel à Chald. נְשַׁר, vel à Rad. שׁוּר cecinit.
נִשְׂרָפָה, נִשְׂרְפָה comburemus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. שָׂרַף.
נִשְׁתָּה periit, Jer. 51. 30. & pro eo, נִשְׁתָּה ; præt. Kal, 3. f.f. Rad. נָשַׁח.
נִשְׁתָּה bibemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. שָׁתָה.
נִשְׁתּוּ defecerunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. נִשַׁח.
נִשְׁתָּוָה æquatur, Prov. 27. 15. comp. ex præt. Niph. נִשְׁוָה, & præt. Hithp. נִשְׁתַּוָּה, 3. f.m. Rad. שָׁוָה.
נִשְׁתָּן diploma, No. f.m. Rad. נָשַׁח defecit.
נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה incurvabimus nos, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. Rad. שָׁחָה.
נִשְׁתָּעֶה stupebimus; fut. Hithp. 1. pl. (pro נִשְׁתָּעֶה,) Rad. שָׁעָה.

page.notes: Vowel points and some Hebrew forms in the small type are hard to read at this scan resolution and may be inexact; the Latin and Hebrew consonants are copied as far as legible. The running head is given for both columns (left "נ ש", right "ש"). Bottom-right mark (נ ת) is treated as a signature.
